verdict.rationale: Morph is an API platform, so an official CLI is a fair thing to ask about, but the evidence documents only an OpenAI-compatible API, SDK components and an MCP server. The only CLI mentioned is a third-party tool (llm.datasette.io) that a user hooked up to the endpoint, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
